Scout.text: The receiving player stayed close enough to the ball for a completed-transfer candidate. This is evidence of reception, not of the passer’s intention.

Guide.text: A completed pass tells you who received the ball. It does not prove the defenders were fooled or that the next attack will succeed.

Host.text: The useful conclusion is narrower: the ball reached a teammate. Evaluate the next action before calling this an advantage.
